name: Herald
description: Herald brings the SkyBlock Engine into the game: timers, crafts, contests and milestones as a toast, a chat line with buttons, and a sound. Client-only: reads a local file written by the SkyBlock Engine bridge; buttons run only /warp, /shnavigate, /recipe, /hub, /is, /pickupstash and /pets, and only when you click them. Pet Guard cancels your own click on an XP reward when the wrong pet is out.
